nodes.label: Tenant-Scoped Backpressure
nodes.rationale: LoopGuard accepts work only when it can preserve it and never returns success for silently dropped work; limits are tenant-scoped so a noisy tenant cannot affect another tenant, and 429 LGAPI-OVERLOADED responses include Retry-After plus bounded deterministic jitter that spreads clients without making retries unpredictable.

nodes.label: Default Production Limit Envelope
nodes.rationale: All limits are explicit LOOPGUARD_API_* settings; the initial defaults are conservative bootstrap values, not a capacity claim, and production changes require a load result, dashboard review, and a rollback value.

nodes.label: k6 Ingest and Stream Load Gates
nodes.rationale: The checked-in k6 scenarios are the release gate; no synthetic laptop result is represented as production capacity, and the authoritative result must be attached to each staging release with at least 30% measured headroom.
